snippet.title: SM64 POWER STAR MADNESS - RomHack - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
SM64 POWER STAR MADNESS - AVAILABLE NOW!!!
DOWNLOAD IT FROM HERE: "https://romhacking.com/hack/sm64-power-star-madness"


Hi! ☆
I present my first Super Mario 64 RomHack: SM64 Power Star Madness!

-this hack is a vanilla style hack cointaning 141 power stars to collect!
featuring +15 levels to explore.
-this is meant to be a full lenght hack.
-difficulty should be a little harder than sm64.
-planning to release in early 2026 if everything goes right
-obvious inspirations are from other hacks like SMSR or SM74 as they were my entry point  to romhacks and they hold a nostalgic place for me.
-various elements were possible thanks to tutorials, guides and help from 
a lot of people, proper thanks should be made when the trailer releases.

-this is been my passion project since a time :D I hope you like it

thanks for reading
☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆


disclaimer: THIS CHANNEL IS NOT MONETIZED AND THE ADS ARE JUST PLACED BY YOUTUBE AND I DON'T SEE A DIME OF THAT :p so consider using an 𝖆dblock𝖊r
